system.description: A candle of grey wax that burns with a black flame and gives no light, made by the cult that welcomes the dark. Once per day, light it: for 1 hour, Duskborn and Shades within 30' take you for one of their own and do not attack you unless you harm them or stand in light. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: Burn it to nothing at dusk: until the next day begins, Duskborn, Shades and undead do not notice the party unless one of you harms them. It gives no light; the dark is still dark.
system.drawback: The dark has learned your scent. The next time you are in complete darkness, a Duskborn foe finds you.
system.faction: the cult of the Last Flame
